phrases.text: Cleopatra's closer to the Moon landing,
than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
The pyramid was finished around 2560 BC.
Cleopatra died in 30 BC. That's about 2,500 years later.
The Moon landing was 1969. Only about 2,000 years after her.
To Cleopatra, the pyramids were already ancient.
So who lived closer to the Moon landing?
